title: Primitive Axiom Layers

title: Compactification Costs

limits: Lens-area, Euler-triangulation and analytic-extension developments were not part of these targets. The DOI is the identifier recorded by the source; this migration does not change the deposit.

title: Golden Phase Prime Ribbons
coverage: Three completed batches cover exact valuation/weighted encoding, positive rational extension, the golden specialization, and routing controls.
limits: Golden transcendence is an explicit hypothesis: Gelfond–Schneider is not proved inside this dependency closure. G06 needs its root-representation/collision qualification. Equal endpoints need not mean equal ordered receipts. The recorded source DOI is not a new publication action.

title: Finite Abstraction Between RH and P versus NP
coverage: Finite-test countermodels, positive unbounded induction, quantifier controls and growing finite records.
limits: No RH, P-versus-NP, lower-bound, reduction or independence result is claimed. Finite evidence and finite descriptions with proved universal reach remain distinct.

title: PAL Single Cut Transport Lemma
coverage: Three completed batches: finite-support counting, filled-corridor invariance and puncture controls, and the seven-column OR gadget with all 40,320 order/truth pairs.
limits: The local lemma audit does not establish a global reduction, minimality or historical priority.

limits: The physical applications need a correct concrete trace model. The original predecessor archive is unavailable for byte verification. The historical alternative-kernel attempt remains blocked. The supplement is separate from the original fifteen declarations.

limits: The inherited APCI/BRIDGE copies remain byte-pinned. Bundled kernel replay is not an independently implemented checker or independent scientific review. Published Zenodo files are unchanged.
